name: Valid player creation returns 201 with player_id
why: The most basic contract: POST /api/players with a valid username must return 201 and an integer player_id. Every other test depends on this working.

name: Player creation response contains player_id as integer not string
why: player_id must be an integer type, not a string. Clients rely on this for subsequent requests.

name: Missing username field returns 400
why: Submitting an empty body with no username field must be rejected. The server must validate required fields.

name: Empty string username returns 400
why: An empty string is not a valid username. The spec requires minLength 1. Server must reject it.

name: Username with special characters returns 400
why: The spec restricts usernames to alphanumeric and underscores only. Special characters like ! must be rejected.

name: Username with spaces returns 400
why: Spaces are not allowed in usernames per the spec pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$. Server must reject.

name: Username at maximum length 30 chars returns 201
why: A 30-character username is at the boundary of the spec maxLength. Server must accept it.

name: Username over maximum length 31 chars returns 400
why: A 31-character username exceeds the spec maxLength of 30. Server must reject it.

name: Username with underscore is valid
why: Underscores are explicitly allowed by the spec pattern. A username like test_user must be accepted.

name: Duplicate username returns 409
why: Creating a player with a username that already exists must return 409 Conflict. This is the majority-rules spec contract.

name: Player creation response has no extra unexpected fields
why: The spec uses additionalProperties: false. The response must contain player_id and nothing that contradicts the schema.

name: Non-existent player stats returns 404
why: Requesting stats for a player ID that does not exist must return 404. Servers must not return 200 with empty data.

name: Fresh player stats has all zero numeric fields
why: A newly created player with no games played must return zeros for games_played, wins, losses, total_shots, total_hits.

name: Fresh player stats accuracy is zero float
why: A player with no shots taken must return accuracy of 0.0 as a float, not an integer 0.

name: Stats response contains all required fields
why: Response must include games_played, wins, losses, total_shots, total_hits, and accuracy. Missing any field violates the spec.

name: Player ID zero returns 404
why: Player ID 0 is below the spec minimum of 1. Server must return 404 or 400, not a server error.

name: Valid game creation returns 201 with game_id and waiting_setup status
why: Core contract for game creation. Must return 201, an integer game_id, and status of waiting_setup.

name: Missing creator_id returns 400
why: creator_id is a required field per the spec schema. Omitting it must result in 400.

name: Missing grid_size returns 400
why: grid_size is a required field per the spec schema. Omitting it must result in 400.

name: Missing max_players returns 400
why: max_players is a required field per the spec schema. Omitting it must result in 400.

name: grid_size below minimum of 5 returns 400
why: The spec sets minimum grid_size at 5. A value of 4 must be rejected with 400.

name: grid_size above maximum of 15 returns 400
why: The spec sets maximum grid_size at 15. A value of 16 must be rejected with 400.

name: grid_size at minimum boundary of 5 returns 201
why: grid_size of exactly 5 is the lower boundary. The server must accept this as valid.

name: grid_size at maximum boundary of 15 returns 201
why: grid_size of exactly 15 is the upper boundary. The server must accept this as valid.

name: max_players below minimum of 2 returns 400
why: The spec sets minimum max_players at 2. A value of 1 must be rejected with 400.

name: Non-existent creator_id returns 400 or 404
why: Providing a creator_id that does not reference any player must be rejected. Server should not silently create orphaned games.

name: Game creation response status is exactly waiting_setup
why: The status field in the game creation response must be the exact string waiting_setup, not waiting or setup or any other variant.

name: Non-existent game ID returns 404
why: Requesting a game that does not exist must return 404. Servers must not return 200 with null fields.

name: Game detail response contains all required fields
why: GET /api/games/{id} must return game_id, grid_size, status, players array, current_turn_player_id, and total_moves.

name: current_turn_player_id is null before game starts
why: Before both players have placed ships, current_turn_player_id must be null. It should only be set once the game is playing.

name: total_moves is zero on a fresh game
why: A newly created game with no moves taken must return total_moves of 0.

name: Game detail shows players array with joined players
why: After both players join, the players array must contain 2 entries each with player_id and ships_remaining.

name: Game detail shows playing status after ships placed
why: Once both players place ships, game status must transition to playing.

name: current_turn_player_id is set when game is playing
why: Once game status is playing, current_turn_player_id must be a non-null integer identifying whose turn it is.

name: Negative game ID returns 404
why: A negative game ID is invalid. Server must return 404 not a server error.

name: Valid join returns 200
why: A player joining an open game in waiting_setup status must receive 200.

name: Missing player_id in join body returns 400
why: player_id is required in the join request body. Omitting it must return 400.

name: Joining a full game returns 400
why: Once a game has reached max_players, any additional join attempt must return 400. This is the spec majority-rules contract.

name: Player joining a game they are already in returns 400
why: A player cannot join the same game twice. The server must detect this and return 400.

name: Joining a non-existent game returns 404
why: Attempting to join a game ID that does not exist must return 404.

name: Joining a game already in playing status returns 400
why: Once a game has transitioned to playing status, new players cannot join. Must return 400.

name: Valid ship placement returns 200
why: Placing exactly 3 valid ships for a joined player must return 200.

name: Placement with fewer than 3 ships returns 400
why: The spec requires exactly 3 ship positions. Submitting only 2 must be rejected with 400.

name: Placement with empty ships array returns 400
why: An empty ships array has no positions. Server must reject this with 400.

name: Placement with duplicate coordinates returns 400
why: Two ships at the same cell is invalid. Server must detect the overlap and return 400.

name: Placement with out-of-bounds row returns 400
why: A ship position with row equal to grid_size is out of bounds. Server must reject with 400.

name: Placement with negative coordinates returns 400
why: Negative row or col values are invalid. Server must reject with 400.

name: Ships submitted as arrays instead of objects returns 400
why: Ships must be objects with row and col keys, not arrays. Sending [[0,0],[2,2],[4,4]] must be rejected.

name: Placing ships twice for same player returns 409
why: A player cannot place ships more than once. The second placement attempt must return 409.

name: Placing ships before joining returns 400 or 403
why: A player who has not joined the game cannot place ships. Server must reject with 400 or 403.

name: Missing player_id in place body returns 400
why: player_id is required in the place request. Omitting it must return 400.

name: Valid fire by player 1 returns 200
why: Player 1 firing on a valid cell during their turn must return 200. This is the core playing mechanic.

name: Fire response contains result field
why: The fire response must contain a result field with value hit or miss. No other values are valid per spec.

name: Fire response contains next_player_id
why: After a valid shot, next_player_id must be present in the response indicating whose turn is next.

name: Fire response contains game_status
why: The fire response must contain game_status reflecting the current game state after the shot.

name: Fire out of turn by player 2 returns 403
why: Player 2 cannot fire when it is player 1s turn. The server must return 403 Forbidden.

name: Fire on already targeted cell returns 409
why: Firing on a cell that has already been targeted must return 409 Conflict.

name: Fire with out-of-bounds row returns 400
why: A fire request targeting a row at or beyond grid_size is out of bounds and must return 400.

name: Fire with out-of-bounds col returns 400
why: A fire request targeting a column at or beyond grid_size is out of bounds and must return 400.

name: Fire with negative row returns 400
why: Negative row values are invalid coordinates. Server must reject with 400.

name: Fire on cell at row 0 col 0 is valid
why: The top-left corner is a valid target. Servers must not treat 0,0 as a special or invalid case.

name: Fire without player_id returns 400
why: player_id is required in the fire request body. Omitting it must return 400.

name: Fire on a finished game returns 400
why: Once a game has status finished, no more shots are allowed. Server must return 400.

name: Fire before placing ships returns 400 or 403
why: A player who has not placed ships cannot fire. The game is not in playing status yet.

name: Fire total_moves increments after shot
why: After a valid fire, GET /api/games/{id} must show total_moves incremented by 1.

name: Move history at game start is empty array
why: GET /api/games/{id}/moves at the start of a game with no shots taken must return 200 and an empty array.

name: Move history for non-existent game returns 404
why: Requesting move history for a game that does not exist must return 404.

name: Valid restart returns 200
why: POST /api/test/games/{id}/restart with correct auth header must return 200.

name: Restart without auth header returns 403
why: The restart endpoint requires X-Test-Password header. Omitting it must return 403.

name: Restart with wrong password returns 403
why: An incorrect X-Test-Password value must be rejected with 403. The endpoint must validate the password.

name: After restart game status returns to waiting_setup
why: After a successful restart, GET /api/games/{id} must show status of waiting_setup.

name: After restart total_moves is zero
why: After a successful restart, total_moves must be reset to 0.

name: Restart non-existent game returns 404
why: Attempting to restart a game ID that does not exist must return 404.

name: GET /api/games returns 200 on empty server
why: Listing all games on an empty server must return 200. The response should be an array, possibly empty.

name: GET /api/players returns 200
why: Listing all players must return 200. Empty array is valid.

name: Very large non-existent game ID returns 404
why: A numeric game ID that does not exist must return 404 not a server error. Large IDs like 999998 confirm the server handles missing resources correctly without crashing.

name: Extremely large player ID returns 404
why: A very large player ID like 999999999 must return 404 not a server error.

name: Fire with missing row returns 400
why: The row field is required for a fire request. Omitting it must return 400.

name: Fire with missing col returns 400
why: The col field is required for a fire request. Omitting it must return 400.

name: Create game with string grid_size returns 400
why: grid_size must be an integer. Sending it as a string must be rejected with 400.

name: Join with string player_id returns 400
why: player_id must be an integer. Sending it as a string must be rejected with 400.

name: Place with missing ships field returns 400
why: The ships field is required in a place request. Omitting it must return 400.

name: Entirely empty fire body returns 400
why: Sending an empty body to the fire endpoint must return 400.

name: Join response body contains status joined
why: The join response body must include a status field with value joined, not just return 200 with an empty body.

name: Joining with non-existent player_id returns 404
why: If the player_id in the join request does not reference any known player, the server must return 404 not 400 or 200.

name: Place response body contains status placed
why: The place response body must include a status field with value placed confirming ship placement was accepted by the server.

name: Placing ships when already placed returns 409 Conflict
why: A second ship placement attempt by the same player must return 409 Conflict, not 400. The first placement succeeded so a repeat is a conflict not a bad request.

name: Fire on a ship cell returns result hit
why: When a shot lands on an opponent ship cell the result field must be the exact string hit. Setup places player 2 ships at row 0 col 1 so player 1 firing there must hit.

name: Fire on an empty cell returns result miss
why: When a shot lands on a cell with no ship the result field must be the exact string miss. Firing at row 7 col 7 which has no setup ships must return miss.

name: Fire response contains game_status field
why: The fire response must include game_status reflecting current game state after the shot. This field is required by the spec alongside result and next_player_id.

name: Stats response contains all six required fields
why: The stats response must include all six spec-required fields: games_played, wins, losses, total_shots, total_hits, and accuracy. Missing any field fails the schema.
